phaseIntent: Pipeline proving gate — prove production ingestion behaves correctly when manuals are useful, redundant, ambiguous, and unfamiliar. NOT a manual usefulness or coverage gate.
notAuthorizingYet: diagnostic UI against production data contract
canonical graph expansion without architecture gate

pilotSuccessDefinition.summary: Pilot success ≠ everything mapped. Success = pipeline lifecycle honored with no silent promotion, guessing, or continuation past architecture exception.
legitimateOutcomes: normalized → architecture_exception → STOP batch for manual
failureModes: continuing batch after architecture_exception without gate closure
mutating frozen canonical hashes without authorized freeze
writing canonical/*.json from normalization or compounding

cohortSelectionRationale: Deliberately stress different pipeline surfaces — known family, cross-manufacturer mapping, frozen range_oven, implementation terminology, microwave functional richness, heat-pump composition/reference, and architecture-exception STOP — not eight easy manuals.

architecture_exception.behavior: STOP batch for affected manual; persist architecture_exception.json; do not process subsequent cohort manuals until human triage
architecture_exception.note: Generic handler is a pilot target — contract + orchestrator prove STOP behavior; full module may harden post-pilot

unresolved.behavior: BLOCK promotion for manual; pilot may continue other manuals unless contract slot marks unresolved as batch-halting

frozen_canonical_immutability.behavior: Any frozen hash mutation without authorized freeze → pilot FAIL

deferredPilotTargets.description: Production-grade generic architecture_exception batch STOP orchestrator
deferredPilotTargets.pilotApproach: Prove via pilot_batch.py + slot P08; harden after GATE green
Prove via hash gate + pipeline write-target tests; interceptor may follow batch authorization

immutableRules: Frozen canonical graphs immutable during pilot
Pilot does not lower CG-5.3 bar

required: All 8 cohort slots executed or explicitly blocked with documented prerequisite (no silent skip)
At least one slot demonstrates canonical_mapping continue path
At least one slot demonstrates implementation_specific overlay path
At least one slot demonstrates unresolved BLOCK
At least one slot demonstrates architecture_exception STOP (slot P08)

stopCondition: Pilot GATE green authorizes 70-manual batch contract. Pilot GATE red blocks batch — fix pipeline behavior, not canonical architecture.
